raised: The '123 מקור / 123 חושב / 123 הזנתי' line is confusing and its meaning is unclear
Unclear what counts as 'לצורך השתלמות' for the 3-year rule
Did not understand 'אג"ח ממשלתית צמודה'
Did not understand the example of ₪10,000 today plus ₪500 a month (has no ₪10,000)
The small ₪415.84 gap after 10 years at first made the fund look barely worth it
Confused why the example uses ₪500 a month when 2.5% of salary is ₪300
The 'ההפרש תלוי גם במי שבוחרים' bullets have too many numbers
'הפקדה אחרי משיכה הולכת לחשבון חדש' did not make sense until the risks section
The 'TXH-09 / KH-15' code tags mean nothing to the reader
The Treasury chief economist note was worrying (could the benefit be cancelled?)
Surprised and puzzled that the fund's costs (₪2,402) are much higher than the securities account's (₪466)
Did not understand terms such as הפקדה מוטבת, רווח ריאלי, ותק, מסלול השקעה, דמי ניהול מחיסכון
No way to tell whether one company (מיטב, הראל, אלטשולר שחם) is better than another
The page doesn't show the actual total including the employer's 7.5% after 6 years
Not clear whether an employee can opt out once it's offered
Not explained what happens to the 6-year clock on changing jobs
No help choosing between the S&P 500 and general tracks
No guidance on whether to withdraw or leave the money after 6 years
Would drop the terms table, the coded 'שווה לדעת' list, the provider cards, the difference bullets, the Treasury note, and the chips

problems.why: The reader repeats the 7.5% employer deposit but never questions whether it goes to the study fund or to a pension fund, so no raised problem matches this one.
